summary: Rewrite analysis.py as default RandomForest (raw 12 features), pick trees {100,500} by repeated 5-fold pilot CV, write cv_auc alone
reasoning: Forest-raw-cv milestone. I rewrite analysis.py as a RandomForestClassifier at sklearn 1.9.1 defaults (max_features='sqrt', unpruned, bootstrap), varying only n_estimators (100 = default, 500) and the seed; model selection and its CV estimate use pilot.csv only, via repeated stratified 5-fold (5 fold seeds) averaged, n_jobs=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1. The script must not open data/heldout.csv in this phase; out/metrics.json gets only cv_auc. I expect the default forest to reach the 0.80 bar on the pilot: the tuned RF route (probe:synth-r1-forest#step-13, cv 0.8931, though with product features) and boost/knn routes (0.83-0.86) show a learnable signal well above the 0.6313 logistic baseline, and a forest picks up interactions by splitting. If cv_auc < 0.80 the plan is contradicted and I reassess within route limits (only tree count and seed may change).
